retrieval_note: Same question corpus, 1600-word ceiling, three repetitions. Adaptive section windows differ from baseline paragraphs. Coverage checks paper identity, not whether all required facts were retrieved. No speed superiority claim is made.

live_cases.question: How do RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token differ in their treatment of retrieved documents during generation?
RAPTOR with GPT-4 reports 82.6% accuracy versus a previous 62.3% on QuALITY. Calculate the absolute gain in percentage points and distinguish it from retrieval speed.
According to ALCE, how do citation recall and citation precision differ, and why is merely checking that a citation identifier exists insufficient?
Compare RAPTOR's hierarchy with HiChunk's hierarchy and retrieval granularity mechanisms. Do these passages establish which has lower query latency?
Synthesize design lessons from DPR, RAPTOR, and Lost in the Middle for selecting evidence for a local literature assistant. Clearly distinguish reported findings from your design inferences.
What exact median wall-clock retrieval latency, in milliseconds, did RAPTOR and HiChunk each achieve on a Dell G15 with an RTX 3050 6 GB GPU?
What exact learning rate was used to fine-tune the HiChunk hierarchy model? The supplied passages discuss only its benchmark motivation and high-level method.

Can we conclude RAPTOR is quantitatively superior to DPR by comparing RAPTOR's 82.6% versus 62.3% QuALITY result with DPR's 9–19% improvement over BM25? Explain what makes this comparison valid or invalid.
